edition_title.en: TLS verification, safer formatting and Delphi mobile networking land together
edition_title.fr: Vérification TLS, formatage sûr et réseau mobile Delphi arrivent ensemble
edition_title.zh: TLS 验证、格式化安全与 Delphi 移动网络支持同时落地
edition_title.ru: TLS-проверка, безопасное форматирование и мобильная сеть Delphi готовы

intro.en: OpenSSL users should take the complete transport sequence: cross-direction socket retries, default hostname verification and error-queue clearing for OpenSSL 1.x/3.x. A one-build FormatAdder regression could write through an invalid destination when formatting empty output. Delphi Android/iOS gain System.Net HTTP backends, Delphi ARMv7 becomes viable, and TXmlParser now accepts simple DOCTYPE declarations without loading DTD entities.
intro.fr: Les utilisateurs OpenSSL doivent prendre toute la séquence transport : retries socket croisés, vérification hostname par défaut et purge de la file d’erreurs sous OpenSSL 1.x/3.x. Une régression d’une build dans FormatAdder pouvait écrire via une destination invalide pour une sortie vide. Delphi Android/iOS gagnent des backends HTTP System.Net, Delphi ARMv7 devient utilisable et TXmlParser accepte les DOCTYPE simples sans charger les entités DTD.
intro.zh: OpenSSL 用户应完整采用本次 transport 序列：跨方向 socket 重试、默认 hostname 验证，以及 OpenSSL 1.x/3.x 的错误队列清理。FormatAdder 曾在一个 build 中于空输出时可能通过无效目标写入。Delphi Android/iOS 新增 System.Net HTTP backend，Delphi ARMv7 可用，TXmlParser 也开始接受简单 DOCTYPE，但不会加载 DTD entity。
intro.ru: Пользователям OpenSSL следует взять всю transport-последовательность: перекрёстные socket retries, проверку hostname по умолчанию и очистку error queue в OpenSSL 1.x/3.x. В одной build регрессия FormatAdder могла писать через неверный адрес при пустом результате. Delphi Android/iOS получают System.Net HTTP backends, Delphi ARMv7 становится рабочим, а TXmlParser принимает простые DOCTYPE без загрузки DTD entities.

en: OpenSSL clients now verify ServerAddress when HostNamesCsv is empty; OpenSSL 1.x/3.x calls clear stale errors before connect, accept, read and write.
Avoid builds 2.4.17025–2.4.17063 for the incomplete OpenSSL retry sequence and build 2.4.17047 for the FormatAdder empty-output overflow path.
Delphi Android and iOS can use TDelphiNetHttp, TRestHttpClientDelphiNet and TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties through the operating-system TLS stack.
Delphi Android ARMv7 receives ABI stubs, aligned packed-field JSON handling and variadic-call support.
TXmlParser ignores simple external DOCTYPE declarations by default; use xpoRejectDocType to retain strict rejection, and note that internal subsets remain unsupported.
fr: Les clients OpenSSL vérifient ServerAddress quand HostNamesCsv est vide ; OpenSSL 1.x/3.x purge les erreurs avant connect, accept, read et write.
Évitez 2.4.17025–2.4.17063 pour la séquence OpenSSL incomplète et 2.4.17047 pour le chemin d’overflow de FormatAdder avec sortie vide.
Delphi Android et iOS peuvent utiliser TDelphiNetHttp, TRestHttpClientDelphiNet et TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties via le TLS de l’OS.
Delphi Android ARMv7 reçoit les stubs ABI, le JSON aligné pour les packed fields et le support des appels variadiques.
TXmlParser ignore les DOCTYPE externes simples par défaut ; utilisez xpoRejectDocType pour les rejeter, les subsets internes restant non pris en charge.
zh: HostNamesCsv 为空时，OpenSSL client 现在验证 ServerAddress；OpenSSL 1.x/3.x 在 connect、accept、read、write 前清理旧错误。
避开 2.4.17025–2.4.17063 的不完整 OpenSSL 重试序列，以及存在 FormatAdder 空输出 overflow 路径的 2.4.17047。
Delphi Android/iOS 可通过 OS TLS 使用 TDelphiNetHttp、TRestHttpClientDelphiNet 与 TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties。
Delphi Android ARMv7 新增 ABI stub、packed field 对齐 JSON 处理和 variadic-call 支持。
TXmlParser 默认忽略简单外部 DOCTYPE；如需严格拒绝请使用 xpoRejectDocType，internal subset 仍不支持。
ru: OpenSSL clients проверяют ServerAddress при пустом HostNamesCsv; OpenSSL 1.x/3.x очищает старые ошибки перед connect, accept, read и write.
Избегайте 2.4.17025–2.4.17063 с незавершёнными OpenSSL retries и 2.4.17047 с overflow-путём FormatAdder для пустого вывода.
Delphi Android/iOS могут использовать TDelphiNetHttp, TRestHttpClientDelphiNet и TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties через TLS операционной системы.
Delphi Android ARMv7 получает ABI stubs, выравнивание packed fields при JSON и variadic-call support.
TXmlParser по умолчанию игнорирует простой внешний DOCTYPE; для строгого отказа используйте xpoRejectDocType, internal subsets не поддерживаются.

title.en: OpenSSL asynchronous transport reaches a safe landing
title.fr: Le transport OpenSSL asynchrone atteint une révision sûre
title.zh: OpenSSL 异步传输达到安全落点
title.ru: Асинхронный transport OpenSSL достигает безопасной версии

summary.en: SSL_read and SSL_write handle the opposite WANT direction with a bounded wait. Client setup now verifies ServerAddress by default, and OpenSSL before 4.x clears its thread error queue before every retried operation.
summary.fr: SSL_read et SSL_write gèrent le WANT opposé avec une attente bornée. Le client vérifie ServerAddress par défaut et OpenSSL antérieur à 4.x purge sa file d’erreurs avant chaque opération réessayée.
summary.zh: SSL_read/SSL_write 以有界等待处理相反 WANT 方向。Client 默认验证 ServerAddress，OpenSSL 4.x 之前版本在每次重试操作前清理线程错误队列。
summary.ru: SSL_read и SSL_write обрабатывают противоположный WANT с ограниченным ожиданием. Client по умолчанию проверяет ServerAddress, а OpenSSL до 4.x очищает thread error queue перед каждой повторной операцией.

title.en: Delphi mobile targets gain native HTTP and repaired ABIs
title.fr: Les cibles mobiles Delphi gagnent HTTP natif et des ABI réparées
title.zh: Delphi 移动目标获得原生 HTTP 与修复后的 ABI
title.ru: Мобильные цели Delphi получают native HTTP и исправленные ABI

summary.en: System.Net.HttpClient becomes the default HTTPS route where Delphi mobile has no libcurl or OpenSSL. ARMv7 receives dedicated interface-call stubs and alignment fixes, while Darwin externals name clib explicitly.
summary.fr: System.Net.HttpClient devient la voie HTTPS par défaut quand Delphi mobile n’a ni libcurl ni OpenSSL. ARMv7 reçoit des stubs d’appel d’interface et des correctifs d’alignement ; Darwin nomme clib explicitement.
summary.zh: 当 Delphi mobile 没有 libcurl/OpenSSL 时，System.Net.HttpClient 成为默认 HTTPS 路径。ARMv7 新增 interface-call stub 与对齐修复，Darwin external 明确指定 clib。
summary.ru: System.Net.HttpClient становится HTTPS-маршрутом по умолчанию, когда Delphi mobile не имеет libcurl/OpenSSL. ARMv7 получает interface-call stubs и alignment fixes, Darwin externals явно указывают clib.

title.en: Logging and formatting are hardened after a dense refactor
title.fr: Logs et formatage sont durcis après un refactor dense
title.zh: 日志与格式化在密集重构后得到加固
title.ru: Логи и форматирование усилены после плотного refactor

summary.en: TSynLog pre-rendering is reorganized and caller stack frames are corrected. Diagnostic strings are bounded without mutating their managed length, SQL parameter logs retain the full statement shape, and FormatAdder avoids writing when formatting produces zero bytes.
summary.fr: Le pré-rendu TSynLog est réorganisé et les frames appelantes sont corrigées. Les diagnostics sont bornés sans modifier la longueur managed, les logs SQL gardent la forme complète et FormatAdder n’écrit plus quand le formatage produit zéro octet.
summary.zh: TSynLog 预渲染被重组，caller stack frame 得到修正。诊断字符串不再通过修改 managed 长度来截断，SQL 参数日志保留完整语句形状，FormatAdder 在零字节结果时不再写入。
summary.ru: Pre-rendering TSynLog реорганизован, caller stack frames исправлены. Диагностика ограничивается без изменения managed length, SQL-логи сохраняют форму запроса, а FormatAdder не пишет при нулевом результате.

title.en: Simple DOCTYPE declarations become explicitly controllable
title.fr: Les DOCTYPE simples deviennent explicitement contrôlables
title.zh: 简单 DOCTYPE 声明变为可显式控制

summary.en: TXmlParser skips simple prolog DOCTYPE declarations by default, rejects nested markup and entity subsets, and offers xpoRejectDocType for strict callers. The final fix preserves the prolog/root state across Save and Restore.
summary.fr: TXmlParser ignore par défaut les DOCTYPE simples du prologue, rejette markup imbriqué et subsets d’entités, et propose xpoRejectDocType aux appelants stricts. Le correctif final préserve l’état prologue/root via Save et Restore.
summary.zh: TXmlParser 默认跳过 prolog 中的简单 DOCTYPE，拒绝嵌套 markup 与 entity subset，并提供 xpoRejectDocType。最终修复在 Save/Restore 间保留 prolog/root 状态。
summary.ru: TXmlParser по умолчанию пропускает простой DOCTYPE в prolog, отклоняет nested markup и entity subsets и предлагает xpoRejectDocType. Финальный fix сохраняет состояние prolog/root через Save/Restore.

avoid.why: The new OpenSSL socket retry path is present, but the final hostname-verification and pre-4.x error-queue fixes are not both included until build 2.4.17064.
The TSynLog pre-render rewrite still has caller-frame and wrapper issues that are completed in build 2.4.17046.
The TFormatUtf8 refactor can call WriteAll with no formatted blocks through FormatAdder; build 2.4.17048 adds the required zero-size guard.

order.why: Take socket retry, default hostname verification and error-queue clearing as one OpenSSL transport sequence.
Take the logging/formatting rewrite together with its stack, wrapper and empty-output corrections.
Take all three DOCTYPE commits so Save/Restore preserves the parser's prolog state.
Take the System.Net transport before its SQL proxy and REST client integrations.
These independent compiler-target fixes complete Delphi Darwin linking and Android ARMv7 execution.

upgrade_advice.en: Land on build 2.4.17065. OpenSSL deployments should test DNS-name and IP connections with an empty HostNamesCsv, certificate rejection, and SSL_read/SSL_write WANT transitions under OpenSSL 1.1 and 3.x. Audit direct UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde callers because it now returns PUtf8Char and replaces every control byte below #32, not only #0. Strict XML consumers should add xpoRejectDocType. Delphi mobile teams should exercise System.Net redirects, compression, proxies and certificate callbacks on each target.
upgrade_advice.fr: Visez la build 2.4.17065. Les déploiements OpenSSL doivent tester noms DNS et IP avec HostNamesCsv vide, certificats rejetés et transitions WANT de SSL_read/SSL_write sous OpenSSL 1.1/3.x. Auditez les appels directs à UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde : la fonction renvoie maintenant PUtf8Char et remplace tous les contrôles sous #32, pas seulement #0. Les consommateurs XML stricts doivent ajouter xpoRejectDocType. Testez redirects, compression, proxies et callbacks certificat de System.Net sur chaque cible mobile Delphi.
upgrade_advice.zh: 请采用 build 2.4.17065。OpenSSL 部署应在 OpenSSL 1.1/3.x 下测试 HostNamesCsv 为空时的 DNS/IP 连接、证书拒绝，以及 SSL_read/SSL_write 的 WANT 转换。检查直接调用 UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde 的代码：它现在返回 PUtf8Char，并替换所有低于 #32 的控制字节，而非仅 #0。严格 XML 消费方应加入 xpoRejectDocType。Delphi mobile 团队应在各目标测试 System.Net redirect、压缩、proxy 与证书 callback。
upgrade_advice.ru: Переходите на build 2.4.17065. Для OpenSSL проверьте DNS/IP при пустом HostNamesCsv, отклонение сертификатов и WANT-переходы SSL_read/SSL_write под OpenSSL 1.1/3.x. Проверьте прямые вызовы UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde: теперь функция возвращает PUtf8Char и заменяет все control bytes ниже #32, а не только #0. Строгим XML-потребителям нужен xpoRejectDocType. На каждой Delphi mobile цели проверьте System.Net redirects, compression, proxy и certificate callbacks.

notes.en: The raw payload contains 24 non-merge commits and 10 merge commits; every non-merge commit is covered. No superseded_by marker is present. The avoid ranges are based on direct follow-up fixes to the same routines within this payload. Version bookkeeping files were ignored.
notes.fr: Le payload brut contient 24 commits non-merge et 10 merges ; chaque commit non-merge est couvert. Aucun marqueur superseded_by n’est présent. Les plages à éviter reposent sur des correctifs directs des mêmes routines dans ce payload. Les fichiers de version ont été ignorés.
notes.zh: 原始 payload 含 24 个 non-merge commit 与 10 个 merge commit；所有 non-merge commit 均已覆盖。没有 superseded_by 标记。避开区间依据本 payload 中对相同 routine 的直接后续修复。版本记录文件已忽略。
notes.ru: Raw payload содержит 24 non-merge commits и 10 merge commits; каждый non-merge commit покрыт. Маркеров superseded_by нет. Диапазоны исключения основаны на прямых последующих fix тех же routines в этом payload. Version bookkeeping files не учитывались.

headline.en: OpenSSL reads and writes retry the opposite socket direction
headline.fr: Les lectures et écritures OpenSSL réessaient la direction socket opposée
headline.zh: OpenSSL 读写会重试相反 socket 方向
headline.ru: OpenSSL read/write повторяют противоположное socket-направление

what_changed.en: TOpenSslNetTls.Receive now waits when SSL_read returns SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE, and Send waits when SSL_write returns SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ. WaitRetry waits in 100 ms slices for the requested TNetEvents and raises after five seconds.
what_changed.fr: TOpenSslNetTls.Receive attend si SSL_read renvoie SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE, et Send attend SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ de SSL_write. WaitRetry attend les TNetEvents par tranches de 100 ms et lève une erreur après cinq secondes.
what_changed.zh: SSL_read 返回 SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE 时 TOpenSslNetTls.Receive 会等待；SSL_write 返回 SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ 时 Send 会等待。WaitRetry 每 100 ms 等待所需 TNetEvents，五秒后超时。
what_changed.ru: TOpenSslNetTls.Receive ждёт при SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE от SSL_read, а Send — при SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ от SSL_write. WaitRetry ждёт нужные TNetEvents по 100 мс и выдаёт timeout через пять секунд.

impact.en: Renegotiation and TLS state changes on asynchronous sockets no longer become immediate read/write failures when OpenSSL needs the opposite network direction.
impact.fr: Les renégociations et transitions TLS sur sockets async ne deviennent plus des échecs immédiats quand OpenSSL attend la direction réseau opposée.
impact.zh: 异步 socket 上的 renegotiation 与 TLS 状态转换在 OpenSSL 需要相反网络方向时不再立即失败。
impact.ru: Renegotiation и TLS-переходы на async sockets больше не завершаются сразу ошибкой, когда OpenSSL нужна противоположная сеть.

action_detail.en: Upgrade through build 2.4.17064 or later and test bidirectional TLS load; do not deploy this retry commit without the later error-queue fix.
action_detail.fr: Passez à 2.4.17064 ou ultérieure et testez la charge TLS bidirectionnelle ; ne déployez pas ce retry sans le correctif ultérieur de file d’erreurs.
action_detail.zh: 升级到 2.4.17064 或更高并测试双向 TLS 负载；不要在缺少后续错误队列修复时单独部署此重试。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь до 2.4.17064 или новее и проверьте двустороннюю TLS-нагрузку; не берите этот retry без последующей очистки error queue.

headline.en: The live DNS test reports timing and raw response details
headline.fr: Le test DNS réel affiche timing et détails de réponse brute
headline.zh: 实时 DNS 测试输出耗时与原始响应详情
headline.ru: Живой DNS-тест выводит время и детали raw response

what_changed.en: The yahoo.com connectivity test now uses DnsQuery, checks raw and parsed header counts, and prints elapsed time, response size, rcode and truncation diagnostics.
what_changed.fr: Le test yahoo.com utilise maintenant DnsQuery, vérifie les compteurs raw/parsé et affiche durée, taille, rcode et troncature.
what_changed.zh: yahoo.com 连通性测试改用 DnsQuery，核对 raw/parsed header 计数，并输出耗时、大小、rcode 与 truncation。
what_changed.ru: Тест yahoo.com теперь использует DnsQuery, сверяет raw/parsed header counts и печатает время, размер, rcode и truncation.

impact.en: Framework behavior is unchanged; failed CI or local network tests provide more actionable DNS evidence.
impact.fr: Le framework ne change pas ; les échecs de tests réseau donnent un diagnostic DNS plus exploitable.
impact.zh: framework 行为不变；CI 或本地网络测试失败时会提供更有用的 DNS 证据。
impact.ru: Поведение framework не меняется; сбои CI или локальных тестов дают более полезную DNS-диагностику.

headline.en: SQL parameter logs keep placeholders after reaching their size limit
headline.fr: Les logs SQL gardent les placeholders après leur limite de taille
headline.zh: SQL 参数日志达到大小限制后仍保留 placeholder
headline.ru: SQL-логи сохраняют placeholders после лимита размера

what_changed.en: TSqlDBStatement.ComputeSqlWithInlinedParams fixes maxAllowed from W.TextLength-maxSize to maxSize-W.TextLength. Once the value budget is exhausted it writes '?' for later parameters and continues through the SQL; getters also tolerate self=nil and exception logging uses the SQL level directly.
what_changed.fr: TSqlDBStatement.ComputeSqlWithInlinedParams corrige maxAllowed en maxSize-W.TextLength. Budget épuisé, il écrit '?' pour les paramètres suivants et poursuit le SQL ; les getters tolèrent self=nil et le log d’exception teste directement le niveau SQL.
what_changed.zh: TSqlDBStatement.ComputeSqlWithInlinedParams 将 maxAllowed 修正为 maxSize-W.TextLength。值预算耗尽后，后续参数写为 '?' 并继续处理完整 SQL；getter 也容忍 self=nil，异常日志直接检查 SQL level。
what_changed.ru: TSqlDBStatement.ComputeSqlWithInlinedParams исправляет maxAllowed на maxSize-W.TextLength. После исчерпания бюджета значения заменяются '?' до конца SQL; getters допускают self=nil, exception logging проверяет SQL level напрямую.

impact.en: Bounded diagnostic SQL no longer underflows its remaining-length calculation or drops the tail of the statement, so failure logs stay structurally useful without exposing oversized values.
impact.fr: Le SQL de diagnostic borné n’underflow plus sa taille restante et ne perd plus la fin de la requête ; les logs gardent une structure utile sans valeurs démesurées.
impact.zh: 有界诊断 SQL 不再发生剩余长度 underflow，也不会丢失语句尾部，因此失败日志保留结构且不暴露过大值。
impact.ru: Ограниченный diagnostic SQL больше не получает underflow остатка и не теряет хвост запроса, сохраняя структуру без чрезмерных значений.

action_detail.en: If operations depend on SQL failure logs, compare LoggedSqlMaxSize output after upgrading.
action_detail.fr: Si vos opérations dépendent des logs d’échec SQL, comparez la sortie de LoggedSqlMaxSize après mise à jour.
action_detail.zh: 若运维依赖 SQL 失败日志，请在升级后比较 LoggedSqlMaxSize 输出。
action_detail.ru: Если эксплуатация зависит от SQL failure logs, сравните вывод LoggedSqlMaxSize после обновления.

headline.en: The failed-statement test uses a silent exception class
headline.fr: Le test de statement en échec utilise une exception silencieuse
headline.zh: statement 失败测试改用静默 exception class
headline.ru: Тест неудачного statement использует silent exception class

what_changed.en: The #606 external-database test raises and expects ESynLogSilent instead of ESqlDBException so an IDE run does not emit the deliberate failure as normal exception noise.
what_changed.fr: Le test de base externe #606 lève et attend ESynLogSilent au lieu de ESqlDBException afin d’éviter le bruit d’exception volontaire dans l’IDE.
what_changed.zh: #606 外部数据库测试改为抛出并期待 ESynLogSilent，而非 ESqlDBException，以免 IDE 运行显示预期失败噪声。
what_changed.ru: Тест внешней БД #606 теперь выбрасывает и ждёт ESynLogSilent вместо ESqlDBException, чтобы IDE не показывала намеренную ошибку как шум.

impact.en: Only test ergonomics change; database exception behavior in application code is unaffected.
impact.fr: Seule l’ergonomie du test change ; les exceptions de base en application sont inchangées.
impact.zh: 仅测试体验变化；应用数据库异常行为不受影响。
impact.ru: Меняется только удобство теста; database exceptions приложения не затронуты.

headline.en: Delphi Darwin links Mach process APIs from clib
headline.fr: Delphi Darwin lie les API process Mach depuis clib
headline.zh: Delphi Darwin 从 clib 链接 Mach process API
headline.ru: Delphi Darwin линкует Mach process API из clib

what_changed.en: The host_processor_info, mach_host_self, vm_deallocate and mach_task_self declarations now specify external clib name instead of treating each symbol name as a library file.
what_changed.fr: Les déclarations host_processor_info, mach_host_self, vm_deallocate et mach_task_self spécifient external clib name au lieu de traiter le symbole comme fichier de bibliothèque.
what_changed.zh: host_processor_info、mach_host_self、vm_deallocate 与 mach_task_self 声明改为指定 external clib name，不再把 symbol 名当作 library file。
what_changed.ru: Объявления host_processor_info, mach_host_self, vm_deallocate и mach_task_self теперь используют external clib name, а не имя symbol как файл библиотеки.

impact.en: Delphi macOS/iOS builds no longer fail at link time with file not found errors for those Mach symbols. FPC keeps the same library resolution.
impact.fr: Les builds Delphi macOS/iOS ne tombent plus au link avec file not found pour ces symboles Mach. La résolution FPC reste identique.
impact.zh: Delphi macOS/iOS build 不再因这些 Mach symbol 出现 file not found 链接错误；FPC 解析保持不变。
impact.ru: Delphi macOS/iOS builds больше не падают при link с file not found для Mach symbols; разрешение FPC не меняется.

action_detail.en: Delphi Darwin projects that hit the Mach linker error should rebuild with this revision or later.
action_detail.fr: Les projets Delphi Darwin touchés par l’erreur de link Mach doivent reconstruire avec cette révision ou ultérieure.
action_detail.zh: 遇到 Mach 链接错误的 Delphi Darwin 项目应使用此 revision 或更高版本重建。
action_detail.ru: Проектам Delphi Darwin с Mach linker error следует пересобраться на этой версии или новее.

headline.en: TDelphiNetHttp embeds the Delphi System.Net transport
headline.fr: TDelphiNetHttp intègre le transport Delphi System.Net
headline.zh: TDelphiNetHttp 内嵌 Delphi System.Net transport
headline.ru: TDelphiNetHttp встраивает transport Delphi System.Net

what_changed.en: TDelphiNetHttp now owns THTTPClient directly in mormot.net.client; the temporary mormot.lib.nethttp unit is removed. It maps timeouts, proxies, headers, authentication, redirects, request streams, response headers and certificate callbacks, and avoids decompressing gzip/deflate twice on iOS.
what_changed.fr: TDelphiNetHttp possède directement THTTPClient dans mormot.net.client ; l’unité temporaire mormot.lib.nethttp disparaît. Il mappe timeouts, proxies, headers, auth, redirects, streams, réponses et certificats, sans redécompresser gzip/deflate sous iOS.
what_changed.zh: TDelphiNetHttp 现在在 mormot.net.client 中直接持有 THTTPClient，临时 mormot.lib.nethttp unit 被移除。它映射 timeout、proxy、header、认证、redirect、stream、响应与证书 callback，并避免 iOS 对 gzip/deflate 二次解压。
what_changed.ru: TDelphiNetHttp теперь напрямую владеет THTTPClient в mormot.net.client; временный unit mormot.lib.nethttp удалён. Он отображает timeouts, proxy, headers, auth, redirects, streams, ответы и certificate callback, избегая двойной распаковки gzip/deflate на iOS.

impact.en: Delphi Android/iOS can issue HTTP and HTTPS through the platform TLS stack without shipping libcurl or OpenSSL. The class does not implement upload/download progress events.
impact.fr: Delphi Android/iOS peut émettre HTTP/HTTPS via le TLS de la plateforme sans livrer libcurl ou OpenSSL. La classe n’implémente pas les événements de progression.
impact.zh: Delphi Android/iOS 可通过平台 TLS 发起 HTTP/HTTPS，无需携带 libcurl/OpenSSL；该 class 不实现上传/下载进度事件。
impact.ru: Delphi Android/iOS может выполнять HTTP/HTTPS через TLS платформы без libcurl/OpenSSL. Класс не реализует progress events загрузки.

action_detail.en: Mobile Delphi projects should test proxy, redirect, compressed-response and certificate-error behavior on every deployed OS version.
action_detail.fr: Les projets Delphi mobiles doivent tester proxy, redirect, réponses compressées et erreurs certificat sur chaque version d’OS déployée.
action_detail.zh: Delphi mobile 项目应在每个部署 OS 版本测试 proxy、redirect、压缩响应与证书错误行为。
action_detail.ru: Мобильным Delphi-проектам следует проверить proxy, redirect, compressed responses и certificate errors на каждой версии OS.

note.en: A public THttpRequest implementation backed by Delphi System.Net.HttpClient is available when USEDELPHINETHTTP is defined.
note.fr: Une implémentation publique de THttpRequest basée sur Delphi System.Net.HttpClient est disponible avec USEDELPHINETHTTP.
note.zh: 定义 USEDELPHINETHTTP 时可使用基于 Delphi System.Net.HttpClient 的公开 THttpRequest 实现。
note.ru: При USEDELPHINETHTTP доступна публичная реализация THttpRequest на Delphi System.Net.HttpClient.

headline.en: Delphi Android ARMv7 gains working interface calls and packed JSON
headline.fr: Delphi Android ARMv7 obtient des interfaces et du JSON packed fonctionnels
headline.zh: Delphi Android ARMv7 获得可用 interface call 与 packed JSON
headline.ru: Delphi Android ARMv7 получает рабочие interface calls и packed JSON

what_changed.en: A compiled ARM object supplies armfakestub, armcallmethod and 128 VMT thunks for Delphi LLVM. ABI handling moves by-reference results to R0 and Self to R1, JSON copies unaligned float/Int64 packed fields through aligned storage, and DispInvoke follows AAPCS32 va_list alignment.
what_changed.fr: Un objet ARM fournit armfakestub, armcallmethod et 128 thunks VMT pour Delphi LLVM. L’ABI place les résultats by-reference dans R0 et Self dans R1, JSON copie les champs packed float/Int64 non alignés et DispInvoke suit l’alignement va_list AAPCS32.
what_changed.zh: 编译后的 ARM object 为 Delphi LLVM 提供 armfakestub、armcallmethod 与 128 个 VMT thunk。ABI 将 by-reference result 放入 R0、Self 放入 R1；JSON 通过对齐副本处理未对齐 packed float/Int64，DispInvoke 遵循 AAPCS32 va_list 对齐。
what_changed.ru: ARM object предоставляет armfakestub, armcallmethod и 128 VMT thunks для Delphi LLVM. ABI помещает by-reference result в R0, Self в R1; JSON использует aligned copy для packed float/Int64, а DispInvoke соблюдает AAPCS32 va_list alignment.

impact.en: Delphi 32-bit Android can execute interface-based SOA/mock calls, serialize packed numeric fields without ARM alignment faults, and pass 64-bit variadic values correctly. Delphi/FPC desktop paths are conditional and unchanged.
impact.fr: Delphi Android 32-bit peut exécuter les appels SOA/mock par interface, sérialiser les champs numériques packed sans alignment fault et passer correctement les valeurs variadiques 64-bit. Les chemins desktop Delphi/FPC ne changent pas.
impact.zh: Delphi 32-bit Android 可执行基于 interface 的 SOA/mock 调用，序列化 packed 数值 field 时避免 ARM alignment fault，并正确传递 64-bit variadic 值。Delphi/FPC desktop 路径由条件编译隔离。
impact.ru: Delphi Android 32-bit может выполнять interface SOA/mock calls, сериализовать packed numbers без ARM alignment fault и правильно передавать 64-bit variadic values. Desktop пути Delphi/FPC не меняются.

action_detail.en: Teams shipping Delphi ARMv7 should rebuild and run interface, variant and packed-record JSON tests on a real 32-bit Android device.
action_detail.fr: Les équipes Delphi ARMv7 doivent reconstruire et tester interfaces, variants et JSON de packed records sur un appareil Android 32-bit réel.
action_detail.zh: 发布 Delphi ARMv7 的团队应重建，并在真实 32-bit Android 设备运行 interface、variant 与 packed-record JSON 测试。
action_detail.ru: Командам Delphi ARMv7 следует пересобрать и проверить interfaces, variants и packed-record JSON на реальном 32-bit Android.

headline.en: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde now returns bounded sanitized text
headline.fr: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde renvoie maintenant un texte borné et nettoyé
headline.zh: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde 现在返回有界净化文本
headline.ru: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde теперь возвращает ограниченный очищенный текст

what_changed.en: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde changes from a procedure to a PUtf8Char-returning function. It terminates the returned view at MaxSize and replaces every byte below #32 with '~', instead of replacing only embedded #0 bytes.
what_changed.fr: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde passe de procedure à function renvoyant PUtf8Char. La vue renvoyée est terminée à MaxSize et tous les octets sous #32 deviennent '~', au lieu des seuls #0.
what_changed.zh: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde 从 procedure 改为返回 PUtf8Char 的 function。返回 view 在 MaxSize 处终止，并将所有低于 #32 的 byte 替换为 '~'，不再只替换嵌入 #0。
what_changed.ru: UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde меняется с procedure на function, возвращающую PUtf8Char. View обрывается на MaxSize, а все bytes ниже #32 заменяются '~', не только #0.

impact.en: Callers can append a bounded C-string without changing the RawUtf8 managed length. Logs also flatten tabs, line breaks and other controls, so exact diagnostic text changes.
impact.fr: Les appelants peuvent ajouter une C-string bornée sans modifier la longueur managed de RawUtf8. Les logs aplatissent aussi tabs, retours ligne et contrôles.
impact.zh: 调用方可追加有界 C-string，而不改变 RawUtf8 managed length。日志也会扁平化 tab、换行及其他控制字符，因此精确文本会变化。
impact.ru: Callers могут добавлять ограниченную C-string без изменения managed length RawUtf8. Логи также заменяют tabs, переводы строк и прочие controls.

action_detail.en: Search for direct UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde calls if code relies on preserving control characters or on the old procedure declaration.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez les appels directs si le code dépend des caractères de contrôle ou de l’ancienne déclaration procedure.
action_detail.zh: 若代码依赖保留控制字符或旧 procedure 声明，请搜索直接调用 UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde 的位置。
action_detail.ru: Найдите прямые вызовы, если код зависит от control chars или старого объявления procedure.

note.en: The routine now returns PUtf8Char and sanitizes all control bytes below #32 while preserving the RawUtf8 allocation length.
note.fr: La routine renvoie PUtf8Char et nettoie tous les octets de contrôle sous #32 sans changer la longueur allouée RawUtf8.
note.zh: 该 routine 现在返回 PUtf8Char，净化所有低于 #32 的控制 byte，同时保留 RawUtf8 allocation length。
note.ru: Routine теперь возвращает PUtf8Char и очищает все control bytes ниже #32, сохраняя allocation length RawUtf8.

headline.en: Batch rollback logs no longer mutate the managed JSON length
headline.fr: Les logs de rollback batch ne modifient plus la longueur managed du JSON
headline.zh: batch rollback 日志不再修改 JSON 的 managed length
headline.ru: Логи batch rollback больше не меняют managed length JSON

what_changed.en: TRestOrmServerBatchSend.OnError passes the PUtf8Char returned by UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde directly to the warning formatter and caps displayed batch data at SizeOf(TBuffer4K), instead of inserting a terminator into fData and logging the managed string.
what_changed.fr: TRestOrmServerBatchSend.OnError passe le PUtf8Char de UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde au formatter et limite les données à SizeOf(TBuffer4K), au lieu d’insérer un terminateur dans fData puis logger la chaîne managed.
what_changed.zh: TRestOrmServerBatchSend.OnError 将 UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde 返回的 PUtf8Char 直接传给 warning formatter，并将显示数据限制为 SizeOf(TBuffer4K)，不再向 fData 插入终止符后记录 managed string。
what_changed.ru: TRestOrmServerBatchSend.OnError передаёт PUtf8Char от UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde в formatter и ограничивает данные SizeOf(TBuffer4K), не вставляя terminator в fData перед логированием managed string.

impact.en: Partial-rollback diagnostics are bounded and single-line while the retained batch buffer remains internally consistent for later cleanup.
impact.fr: Les diagnostics de rollback partiel sont bornés et sur une ligne, tandis que le buffer batch reste cohérent pour le nettoyage ultérieur.
impact.zh: 部分 rollback 诊断变为有界单行，同时保留的 batch buffer 在后续清理时保持内部一致。
impact.ru: Диагностика partial rollback ограничена одной строкой, а batch buffer остаётся согласованным для последующей очистки.

headline.en: SOA contract errors expose only one kilobyte of sanitized JSON
headline.fr: Les erreurs de contrat SOA exposent un kilo-octet de JSON nettoyé
headline.zh: SOA contract 错误仅显示一千字节净化 JSON
headline.ru: Ошибки SOA contract показывают только килобайт очищенного JSON

what_changed.en: TServiceFactoryClient.FakeContractRetrieve builds its invalid-response message with Join and the bounded PUtf8Char view from UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde, capped at 1 KB.
what_changed.fr: TServiceFactoryClient.FakeContractRetrieve construit son message de réponse invalide avec Join et la vue PUtf8Char bornée de UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde, limitée à 1 Ko.
what_changed.zh: TServiceFactoryClient.FakeContractRetrieve 使用 Join 与 UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde 的有界 PUtf8Char view 构建无效响应消息，上限 1 KB。
what_changed.ru: TServiceFactoryClient.FakeContractRetrieve строит сообщение о неверном ответе через Join и ограниченный PUtf8Char от UniqueRawUtf8ZeroToTilde, максимум 1 KB.

impact.en: Malformed or unexpected SOA responses no longer append the unbounded tail of the managed string after an inserted terminator; diagnostics remain compact and single-line.
impact.fr: Les réponses SOA invalides n’ajoutent plus la fin non bornée de la managed string après un terminateur ; le diagnostic reste compact et sur une ligne.
impact.zh: 异常 SOA 响应不再在插入终止符后追加 managed string 的无界尾部；诊断保持紧凑单行。
impact.ru: Неверные SOA responses больше не добавляют неограниченный хвост managed string после terminator; диагностика компактна и однострочна.

headline.en: TSynLog formatting state moves into one pre-render record
headline.fr: L’état de formatage TSynLog passe dans un record de pré-rendu
headline.zh: TSynLog 格式化状态集中到单个预渲染 record
headline.ru: Состояние форматирования TSynLog переходит в pre-render record

what_changed.en: TPreRenderFmt groups format, arguments, instance, length and the 4 KB stack buffer. TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt and formatted Enter/Log paths pass this record instead of many parameters while retaining the direct-rendering fallback.
what_changed.fr: TPreRenderFmt regroupe format, arguments, instance, longueur et buffer stack de 4 Ko. TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt et les chemins Enter/Log passent ce record au lieu de nombreux paramètres, avec le même fallback direct.
what_changed.zh: TPreRenderFmt 汇集 format、argument、instance、length 与 4 KB stack buffer。TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt 及格式化 Enter/Log 路径传递该 record，保留 direct-rendering fallback。
what_changed.ru: TPreRenderFmt объединяет format, arguments, instance, length и stack buffer 4 KB. TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt и форматированные Enter/Log передают record вместо множества параметров, сохраняя direct-rendering fallback.

impact.en: This is internal plumbing with no intended API or output change, but it begins the logging sequence completed by the following fixes.
impact.fr: C’est une plomberie interne sans changement d’API ou de sortie voulu, mais elle ouvre la séquence complétée par les correctifs suivants.
impact.zh: 这是内部 plumbing，无预期 API 或输出变化，但它开启了后续修复完成的日志序列。
impact.ru: Это внутренняя plumbing без ожидаемого изменения API/вывода, но она начинает последовательность последующих fixes.

headline.en: TSynLog stack traces start at the application caller
headline.fr: Les stack traces TSynLog commencent chez l’appelant applicatif
headline.zh: TSynLog stack trace 从应用 caller 开始
headline.ru: Stack traces TSynLog начинаются с application caller

what_changed.en: LockAndPrepareWrite accepts a skip count and adds it to AppendCallerShort. Internal formatted, text and RTTI wrappers skip their own frame, while direct Log and Enter paths retain their intended depth; the formatted Enter overload is also expanded instead of redirecting through EnterLocal.
what_changed.fr: LockAndPrepareWrite accepte un skip ajouté à AppendCallerShort. Les wrappers formatés, texte et RTTI sautent leur frame, tandis que Log/Enter directs gardent leur profondeur ; l’overload Enter formaté n’est plus redirigé via EnterLocal.
what_changed.zh: LockAndPrepareWrite 接受 skip count 并传给 AppendCallerShort。格式化、文本与 RTTI wrapper 跳过自身 frame，直接 Log/Enter 保持预期 depth；格式化 Enter overload 也不再重定向到 EnterLocal。
what_changed.ru: LockAndPrepareWrite принимает skip для AppendCallerShort. Форматированные, text и RTTI wrappers пропускают свой frame, прямые Log/Enter сохраняют depth; форматированный Enter больше не перенаправляется через EnterLocal.

impact.en: LevelStackTrace output points to the application call site instead of TSynLog wrapper internals, improving source attribution in production logs.
impact.fr: LevelStackTrace pointe vers l’appel applicatif au lieu des wrappers internes TSynLog, améliorant l’attribution dans les logs.
impact.zh: LevelStackTrace 输出指向应用调用点，而非 TSynLog wrapper 内部，从而改进生产日志源码定位。
impact.ru: LevelStackTrace указывает на application call site вместо внутренних wrappers TSynLog, улучшая атрибуцию логов.

action_detail.en: If tooling parses exact stack positions, compare representative LevelStackTrace lines after upgrading through build 2.4.17046.
action_detail.fr: Si un outil parse les positions exactes, comparez des lignes LevelStackTrace après passage à 2.4.17046 ou plus.
action_detail.zh: 若工具解析精确 stack position，请升级到 2.4.17046 或更高后比较代表性 LevelStackTrace 行。
action_detail.ru: Если tooling разбирает точные stack positions, сравните LevelStackTrace после обновления до 2.4.17046 или новее.

headline.en: TSynLog headers are prepared consistently inside the owned lock
headline.fr: Les headers TSynLog sont préparés uniformément sous le verrou détenu
headline.zh: TSynLog header 在持有锁时统一准备
headline.ru: Headers TSynLog единообразно готовятся под удерживаемым lock

what_changed.en: LockAndPrepareWrite and LockAndPrepareEnter now receive the instance and call LogHeader after acquiring the writer lock. All call paths drop duplicate header calls, and the UnicodeString Log overload forwards aInstance rather than the wrong Instance identifier.
what_changed.fr: LockAndPrepareWrite et LockAndPrepareEnter reçoivent l’instance et appellent LogHeader après le verrou writer. Les appels dupliqués disparaissent et l’overload UnicodeString transmet aInstance plutôt que le mauvais identifiant Instance.
what_changed.zh: LockAndPrepareWrite/LockAndPrepareEnter 现在接收 instance，并在获取 writer lock 后调用 LogHeader。所有路径移除重复调用，UnicodeString Log overload 传递 aInstance，而非错误的 Instance 标识符。
what_changed.ru: LockAndPrepareWrite/LockAndPrepareEnter получают instance и вызывают LogHeader после writer lock. Дубли удалены, а UnicodeString Log overload передаёт aInstance вместо неверного Instance.

impact.en: Log headers and object attribution are consistent across raw, text, RTTI and Enter calls; UnicodeString logs no longer risk associating the wrong instance.
impact.fr: Headers et attribution d’objet sont cohérents pour raw, texte, RTTI et Enter ; les logs UnicodeString n’associent plus la mauvaise instance.
impact.zh: raw、text、RTTI 与 Enter 调用的 log header 和对象归属保持一致；UnicodeString 日志不再可能关联错误 instance。
impact.ru: Log headers и object attribution согласованы для raw, text, RTTI и Enter; UnicodeString logs больше не рискуют связать неверный instance.

action_detail.en: Take build 2.4.17046 or later if the TSynLog pre-render sequence is present.
action_detail.fr: Prenez la build 2.4.17046 ou ultérieure si la séquence de pré-rendu TSynLog est présente.
action_detail.zh: 若已包含 TSynLog 预渲染序列，请采用 build 2.4.17046 或更高。
action_detail.ru: Если присутствует pre-render sequence TSynLog, берите build 2.4.17046 или новее.

headline.en: TFormatUtf8 and TSynLog wrappers are simplified internally
headline.fr: Les wrappers TFormatUtf8 et TSynLog sont simplifiés en interne
headline.zh: TFormatUtf8 与 TSynLog wrapper 完成内部简化
headline.ru: Wrappers TFormatUtf8 и TSynLog упрощены внутри

what_changed.en: TFormatUtf8 tracks last/max directly and uses a shared WriteAll helper; TSynLog replaces its LogFmt method with AddPreRenderFmt. SQLite logging comments now document the 4 KB pre-render cap. No functional change was intended.
what_changed.fr: TFormatUtf8 suit last/max directement et utilise un helper WriteAll partagé ; TSynLog remplace LogFmt par AddPreRenderFmt. Les commentaires SQLite documentent la limite de pré-rendu de 4 Ko. Aucun changement fonctionnel n’était voulu.
what_changed.zh: TFormatUtf8 直接跟踪 last/max 并使用共享 WriteAll helper；TSynLog 以 AddPreRenderFmt 替代 LogFmt。SQLite 日志注释记录 4 KB 预渲染上限。无预期功能变化。
what_changed.ru: TFormatUtf8 напрямую хранит last/max и использует общий WriteAll; TSynLog заменяет LogFmt на AddPreRenderFmt. Комментарии SQLite фиксируют лимит pre-render 4 KB. Функциональных изменений не планировалось.

impact.en: The refactor itself is internal, but its FormatAdder zero-output edge case is fixed immediately by the next non-merge commit; do not stop on build 2.4.17047.
impact.fr: Le refactor est interne, mais son cas FormatAdder à sortie vide est corrigé immédiatement au commit suivant ; ne restez pas sur 2.4.17047.
impact.zh: 重构本身为内部变化，但其 FormatAdder 零输出边界问题由下一 non-merge commit 立即修复；不要停留在 2.4.17047。
impact.ru: Refactor внутренний, но крайний случай FormatAdder с пустым выводом исправлен следующим commit; не оставайтесь на 2.4.17047.

headline.en: FormatAdder no longer writes through an empty formatter state
headline.fr: FormatAdder n’écrit plus avec un état de formatter vide
headline.zh: FormatAdder 不再通过空 formatter 状态写入
headline.ru: FormatAdder больше не пишет через пустое состояние formatter

what_changed.en: FormatAdder now calls Dest.Add and WriteAll only when TFormatUtf8.size is non-zero. Empty formats or arguments therefore never enter WriteAll with no initialized blocks.
what_changed.fr: FormatAdder appelle Dest.Add et WriteAll seulement si TFormatUtf8.size est non nul. Un format ou des arguments vides n’entrent plus dans WriteAll sans bloc initialisé.
what_changed.zh: FormatAdder 仅在 TFormatUtf8.size 非零时调用 Dest.Add 与 WriteAll。空 format 或 argument 不再以未初始化 block 进入 WriteAll。
what_changed.ru: FormatAdder вызывает Dest.Add и WriteAll только при ненулевом TFormatUtf8.size. Пустой format/arguments больше не входят в WriteAll без initialized blocks.

impact.en: The one-build regression could read uninitialized formatter entries and copy through the destination returned for a zero-byte append, causing a buffer overrun or crash. The guard removes that path.
impact.fr: La régression d’une build pouvait lire des entrées non initialisées et copier via la destination d’un append de zéro octet, causant overflow ou crash. Le guard supprime ce chemin.
impact.zh: 这一 build 的回归可能读取未初始化 formatter entry，并通过零字节 append 返回的目标复制，造成 buffer overrun 或 crash；新增 guard 移除该路径。
impact.ru: Регрессия одной build могла читать uninitialized formatter entries и копировать через destination нулевого append, вызывая buffer overrun или crash. Guard устраняет путь.

action_detail.en: Do not ship build 2.4.17047; use 2.4.17048 or later wherever FormatAdder is reachable.
action_detail.fr: Ne livrez pas la build 2.4.17047 ; utilisez 2.4.17048 ou ultérieure si FormatAdder est accessible.
action_detail.zh: 不要发布 build 2.4.17047；任何可达 FormatAdder 的场景都应使用 2.4.17048 或更高。
action_detail.ru: Не выпускайте build 2.4.17047; используйте 2.4.17048 или новее везде, где доступен FormatAdder.

note.en: Formatting zero bytes now performs no destination allocation or write.
note.fr: Un formatage de zéro octet n’alloue plus de destination et n’écrit rien.
note.zh: 格式化结果为零字节时不再分配目标或写入。
note.ru: При результате в ноль bytes destination не выделяется и запись не выполняется.

headline.en: Log viewer captions expose platform details and tighter rows
headline.fr: Les titres du log viewer affichent la plateforme et des lignes plus serrées
headline.zh: log viewer 标题显示平台信息并收紧行高
headline.ru: Log viewer показывает платформу и делает строки плотнее

what_changed.en: TMainLogView adds OS_TEXT and CPU_ARCH_TEXT to its caption and adjusts event/list row-height calculations. A JSON indentation-only correction is included.
what_changed.fr: TMainLogView ajoute OS_TEXT et CPU_ARCH_TEXT au titre et ajuste le calcul de hauteur des lignes. Une correction d’indentation JSON est incluse.
what_changed.zh: TMainLogView 在标题加入 OS_TEXT 与 CPU_ARCH_TEXT，并调整 event/list 行高计算；另含 JSON 缩进修正。
what_changed.ru: TMainLogView добавляет OS_TEXT и CPU_ARCH_TEXT в caption и меняет расчёт высоты строк. Также исправлен JSON indent.

impact.en: Only the desktop log viewer presentation changes; framework logging and JSON serialization behavior are unaffected.
impact.fr: Seule la présentation du log viewer desktop change ; le logging et la sérialisation JSON restent identiques.
impact.zh: 仅 desktop log viewer 展示变化；framework 日志与 JSON 序列化行为不受影响。
impact.ru: Меняется только desktop log viewer; framework logging и JSON serialization не затронуты.

headline.en: Remote SQL proxy access gains a Delphi System.Net backend
headline.fr: Le proxy SQL distant gagne un backend Delphi System.Net
headline.zh: 远程 SQL proxy 新增 Delphi System.Net backend
headline.ru: Удалённый SQL proxy получает backend Delphi System.Net

what_changed.en: mormot.db.proxy adds TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties under USEDELPHINETHTTP. Its constructor creates TDelphiNetHttp and the class is registered for definition-based construction.
what_changed.fr: mormot.db.proxy ajoute TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties sous USEDELPHINETHTTP. Son constructeur crée TDelphiNetHttp et la classe est enregistrée pour la construction par définition.
what_changed.zh: mormot.db.proxy 在 USEDELPHINETHTTP 下新增 TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties；constructor 创建 TDelphiNetHttp，并注册 class 以支持 definition-based construction。
what_changed.ru: mormot.db.proxy добавляет TSqlDBDelphiNetConnectionProperties под USEDELPHINETHTTP. Constructor создаёт TDelphiNetHttp, класс регистрируется для definition-based construction.

impact.en: Delphi mobile clients can reach a remote mormot.db.sql service over HTTP/HTTPS using the operating-system networking stack.
impact.fr: Les clients Delphi mobiles peuvent joindre un service mormot.db.sql distant en HTTP/HTTPS via le réseau de l’OS.
impact.zh: Delphi mobile client 可通过 OS 网络栈以 HTTP/HTTPS 访问远程 mormot.db.sql service。
impact.ru: Delphi mobile clients могут обращаться к удалённому mormot.db.sql по HTTP/HTTPS через сетевой stack OS.

action_detail.en: Projects selecting this backend should run authentication and remote-statement tests on the target mobile OS.
action_detail.fr: Les projets choisissant ce backend doivent tester authentification et statements distants sur l’OS mobile cible.
action_detail.zh: 选择此 backend 的项目应在目标 mobile OS 上运行认证与远程 statement 测试。
action_detail.ru: Проектам с этим backend следует проверить authentication и remote statements на целевой mobile OS.

note.en: A public HTTP SQL-proxy connection class backed by TDelphiNetHttp is available with USEDELPHINETHTTP.
note.fr: Une classe publique de connexion SQL proxy HTTP basée sur TDelphiNetHttp est disponible avec USEDELPHINETHTTP.
note.zh: 定义 USEDELPHINETHTTP 时可使用基于 TDelphiNetHttp 的公开 HTTP SQL-proxy connection class。
note.ru: При USEDELPHINETHTTP доступен публичный HTTP SQL-proxy connection class на TDelphiNetHttp.

headline.en: REST HTTPS defaults to Delphi System.Net on supported mobile targets
headline.fr: REST HTTPS choisit Delphi System.Net sur les cibles mobiles prises en charge
headline.zh: 支持的移动目标默认使用 Delphi System.Net 处理 REST HTTPS
headline.ru: REST HTTPS по умолчанию использует Delphi System.Net на mobile targets

what_changed.en: TRestHttpClientDelphiNet maps TRestHttpClientRequest to TDelphiNetHttp. When USELIBCURL is absent and USEDELPHINETHTTP is set, TRestHttpsClient aliases this new class instead of the socket client.
what_changed.fr: TRestHttpClientDelphiNet mappe TRestHttpClientRequest vers TDelphiNetHttp. Sans USELIBCURL et avec USEDELPHINETHTTP, TRestHttpsClient devient cet alias au lieu du client socket.
what_changed.zh: TRestHttpClientDelphiNet 将 TRestHttpClientRequest 映射到 TDelphiNetHttp。没有 USELIBCURL 且定义 USEDELPHINETHTTP 时，TRestHttpsClient alias 改用新 class，而非 socket client。
what_changed.ru: TRestHttpClientDelphiNet связывает TRestHttpClientRequest с TDelphiNetHttp. Без USELIBCURL и с USEDELPHINETHTTP alias TRestHttpsClient указывает на новый class вместо socket client.

impact.en: Existing TRestHttpsClient source on Delphi Android/iOS can acquire HTTPS support through the OS TLS implementation without changing the class name.
impact.fr: Le code TRestHttpsClient existant sur Delphi Android/iOS obtient HTTPS via le TLS de l’OS sans changer de nom de classe.
impact.zh: Delphi Android/iOS 上现有 TRestHttpsClient 源码无需改 class 名即可通过 OS TLS 获得 HTTPS 支持。
impact.ru: Существующий код TRestHttpsClient на Delphi Android/iOS получает HTTPS через TLS OS без смены имени class.

action_detail.en: Verify that mobile builds resolve TRestHttpsClient to the intended backend and test authentication plus certificate policy.
action_detail.fr: Vérifiez que les builds mobiles résolvent TRestHttpsClient vers le backend prévu et testez auth et politique certificat.
action_detail.zh: 确认 mobile build 将 TRestHttpsClient 解析为预期 backend，并测试认证与证书策略。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте, что mobile builds связывают TRestHttpsClient с нужным backend, и протестируйте auth/certificate policy.

note.en: A public REST client class backed by Delphi System.Net.HttpClient is conditionally available.
note.fr: Une classe publique de client REST basée sur Delphi System.Net.HttpClient est disponible conditionnellement.
note.zh: 新增条件可用、基于 Delphi System.Net.HttpClient 的公开 REST client class。
note.ru: Условно доступен публичный REST client class на Delphi System.Net.HttpClient.

note.en: With USEDELPHINETHTTP and without USELIBCURL, the alias now selects TRestHttpClientDelphiNet.
note.fr: Avec USEDELPHINETHTTP et sans USELIBCURL, l’alias sélectionne maintenant TRestHttpClientDelphiNet.
note.zh: 定义 USEDELPHINETHTTP 且未定义 USELIBCURL 时，该 alias 现在选择 TRestHttpClientDelphiNet。
note.ru: При USEDELPHINETHTTP без USELIBCURL alias теперь выбирает TRestHttpClientDelphiNet.

headline.en: TXmlParser accepts simple DOCTYPE declarations by default
headline.fr: TXmlParser accepte les déclarations DOCTYPE simples par défaut
headline.zh: TXmlParser 默认接受简单 DOCTYPE 声明
headline.ru: TXmlParser по умолчанию принимает простые DOCTYPE

what_changed.en: TXmlParser recognizes a prolog <!DOCTYPE name ...> and skips to its closing '>' while respecting quotes. It rejects declarations after the root, internal subsets, nested '<' markup and custom entities; xpoRejectDocType restores unconditional rejection.
what_changed.fr: TXmlParser reconnaît <!DOCTYPE name ...> dans le prologue et saute jusqu’au '>' en respectant les quotes. Il rejette les déclarations après root, subsets internes, markup '<' imbriqué et entités custom ; xpoRejectDocType rétablit le rejet total.
what_changed.zh: TXmlParser 识别 prolog 中的 <!DOCTYPE name ...>，并在尊重 quote 的情况下跳到闭合 '>'。root 后声明、internal subset、嵌套 '<' markup 与自定义 entity 仍被拒绝；xpoRejectDocType 可恢复全部拒绝。
what_changed.ru: TXmlParser распознаёт <!DOCTYPE name ...> в prolog и пропускает до '>', учитывая quotes. DOCTYPE после root, internal subsets, nested '<' и custom entities отклоняются; xpoRejectDocType возвращает полный отказ.

impact.en: SVG and other XML with an external SYSTEM/PUBLIC declaration can parse without loading the DTD. Strict callers that previously depended on xpeUnsupportedMarkup must opt into xpoRejectDocType.
impact.fr: SVG et autres XML avec déclaration SYSTEM/PUBLIC externe peuvent être parsés sans charger la DTD. Les appelants stricts dépendant de xpeUnsupportedMarkup doivent choisir xpoRejectDocType.
impact.zh: 含外部 SYSTEM/PUBLIC 声明的 SVG/XML 可在不加载 DTD 的情况下解析。此前依赖 xpeUnsupportedMarkup 的严格调用方必须启用 xpoRejectDocType。
impact.ru: SVG/XML с внешним SYSTEM/PUBLIC может разбираться без загрузки DTD. Строгие callers, зависевшие от xpeUnsupportedMarkup, должны включить xpoRejectDocType.

action_detail.en: Add xpoRejectDocType anywhere policy requires rejecting every DOCTYPE rather than safely ignoring simple declarations.
action_detail.fr: Ajoutez xpoRejectDocType partout où la politique exige de rejeter tout DOCTYPE au lieu d’ignorer les déclarations simples.
action_detail.zh: 若策略要求拒绝所有 DOCTYPE，而非安全忽略简单声明，请加入 xpoRejectDocType。
action_detail.ru: Добавьте xpoRejectDocType там, где политика требует отклонять любой DOCTYPE, а не безопасно игнорировать простой.

note.en: The new TXmlParserOption forces the former behavior of rejecting every DOCTYPE declaration.
note.fr: Le nouveau TXmlParserOption force l’ancien comportement qui rejetait toute déclaration DOCTYPE.
note.zh: 新的 TXmlParserOption 强制恢复拒绝所有 DOCTYPE 声明的旧行为。
note.ru: Новый TXmlParserOption возвращает прежнее поведение с отказом для любого DOCTYPE.

headline.en: DOCTYPE scanning is simplified without widening accepted markup
headline.fr: Le scan DOCTYPE est simplifié sans élargir le markup accepté
headline.zh: DOCTYPE 扫描简化，但未扩大可接受 markup
headline.ru: Сканирование DOCTYPE упрощено без расширения допустимого markup

what_changed.en: ParseDocType centralizes the root-state, option, name and bounds checks, then scans quotes and forbidden markup in one loop. Tests add a comment-before-DOCTYPE prolog case.
what_changed.fr: ParseDocType centralise les contrôles root, option, nom et limites, puis scanne quotes et markup interdit en une boucle. Les tests ajoutent un commentaire avant DOCTYPE.
what_changed.zh: ParseDocType 集中 root state、option、name 与边界检查，再以单循环扫描 quote 和禁止 markup；测试新增 DOCTYPE 前 comment 场景。
what_changed.ru: ParseDocType объединяет проверки root state, option, имени и границ, затем одним циклом сканирует quotes и запрещённый markup. Добавлен тест comment перед DOCTYPE.

impact.en: No intended public behavior changes beyond the preceding DOCTYPE feature; the accepted and rejected forms remain covered by tests.
impact.fr: Aucun changement public voulu au-delà de la feature précédente ; les formes acceptées et rejetées restent testées.
impact.zh: 除前一 DOCTYPE feature 外无预期公开行为变化；接受与拒绝形式仍由测试覆盖。
impact.ru: Публичное поведение сверх предыдущей feature не меняется; accepted/rejected формы покрыты тестами.

headline.en: XML Save and Restore preserve whether a DOCTYPE is still legal
headline.fr: XML Save et Restore préservent si un DOCTYPE reste autorisé
headline.zh: XML Save/Restore 保留 DOCTYPE 是否仍合法的状态
headline.ru: XML Save/Restore сохраняют допустимость DOCTYPE

what_changed.en: TXmlParser.Save stores fStackLen[0] in the spare byte of its saved QWord and Restore writes it back. This preserves the parser's prolog-versus-root state along with Kind, Depth and cursor position.
what_changed.fr: TXmlParser.Save stocke fStackLen[0] dans l’octet libre du QWord sauvegardé et Restore le restitue. L’état prologue/root est préservé avec Kind, Depth et la position.
what_changed.zh: TXmlParser.Save 将 fStackLen[0] 存入保存 QWord 的空闲 byte，Restore 再写回，从而与 Kind、Depth、cursor position 一起保留 prolog/root 状态。
what_changed.ru: TXmlParser.Save сохраняет fStackLen[0] в свободном byte QWord, а Restore восстанавливает его. Состояние prolog/root сохраняется вместе с Kind, Depth и cursor.

impact.en: Speculative parsing around a prolog DOCTYPE can be restored and replayed without falsely treating the declaration as occurring after the document element.
impact.fr: Un parsing spéculatif autour du DOCTYPE peut être restauré et rejoué sans considérer à tort la déclaration comme postérieure au root.
impact.zh: 围绕 prolog DOCTYPE 的 speculative parsing 可恢复并重放，不会误判声明位于 document element 之后。
impact.ru: Speculative parsing вокруг prolog DOCTYPE можно восстановить и повторить без ложного решения, что декларация идёт после root.

action_detail.en: Use build 2.4.17062 or later if TXmlParser Save/Restore is combined with documents containing DOCTYPE.
action_detail.fr: Utilisez 2.4.17062 ou ultérieure si TXmlParser Save/Restore traite des documents avec DOCTYPE.
action_detail.zh: 若 TXmlParser Save/Restore 处理含 DOCTYPE 的文档，请使用 build 2.4.17062 或更高。
action_detail.ru: Используйте build 2.4.17062 или новее, если TXmlParser Save/Restore работает с DOCTYPE.

headline.en: OpenSSL clients verify ServerAddress when no hostname list is supplied
headline.fr: Les clients OpenSSL vérifient ServerAddress sans liste de hostnames
headline.zh: 未提供 hostname 列表时 OpenSSL client 验证 ServerAddress
headline.ru: OpenSSL client проверяет ServerAddress без списка hostnames

what_changed.en: TOpenSslNetTls.AfterConnection now assigns ServerAddress to SSL_set1_host when Context.HostNamesCsv is empty. Explicit CSV names still use the first name with SSL_set1_host and later names with SSL_add1_host; partial wildcards remain disabled.
what_changed.fr: TOpenSslNetTls.AfterConnection passe ServerAddress à SSL_set1_host quand Context.HostNamesCsv est vide. Les noms CSV explicites utilisent toujours SSL_set1_host puis SSL_add1_host ; les wildcards partiels restent interdits.
what_changed.zh: Context.HostNamesCsv 为空时，TOpenSslNetTls.AfterConnection 现在把 ServerAddress 传给 SSL_set1_host。显式 CSV name 仍以第一个调用 SSL_set1_host，后续调用 SSL_add1_host；partial wildcard 仍禁用。
what_changed.ru: TOpenSslNetTls.AfterConnection передаёт ServerAddress в SSL_set1_host при пустом Context.HostNamesCsv. Явные CSV names используют SSL_set1_host для первого и SSL_add1_host для остальных; partial wildcards запрещены.

impact.en: Previously, a default OpenSSL client with certificate checking enabled but no HostNamesCsv verified the chain without configuring the expected peer hostname. It now rejects a validly signed certificate for another host.
impact.fr: Avant, un client OpenSSL par défaut avec contrôle certificat mais sans HostNamesCsv vérifiait la chaîne sans hostname attendu. Il rejette maintenant un certificat signé valide pour un autre host.
impact.zh: 此前启用证书检查但未设置 HostNamesCsv 的默认 OpenSSL client 只验证证书链，却未配置预期 peer hostname；现在会拒绝为其他 host 签发的有效证书。
impact.ru: Ранее OpenSSL client с проверкой сертификата, но без HostNamesCsv проверял chain без expected hostname. Теперь сертификат другого host отклоняется.

action_detail.en: Upgrade OpenSSL clients and test both DNS names and literal IP endpoints; set HostNamesCsv explicitly when the certificate identity differs from ServerAddress.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à jour les clients OpenSSL et testez noms DNS et IP ; définissez HostNamesCsv si l’identité du certificat diffère de ServerAddress.
action_detail.zh: 升级 OpenSSL client 并测试 DNS name 与字面 IP endpoint；若证书 identity 与 ServerAddress 不同，请显式设置 HostNamesCsv。
action_detail.ru: Обновите OpenSSL clients и проверьте DNS/IP endpoints; задайте HostNamesCsv явно, если identity сертификата отличается от ServerAddress.

note.en: Empty HostNamesCsv now means verify ServerAddress, not skip hostname verification.
note.fr: HostNamesCsv vide signifie maintenant vérifier ServerAddress, pas ignorer le hostname.
note.zh: HostNamesCsv 为空现在表示验证 ServerAddress，而非跳过 hostname 验证。
note.ru: Пустой HostNamesCsv теперь означает проверку ServerAddress, а не пропуск hostname verification.

headline.en: OpenSSL 1.x and 3.x retries start with a clean error queue
headline.fr: Les retries OpenSSL 1.x et 3.x démarrent avec une file d’erreurs vide
headline.zh: OpenSSL 1.x/3.x 重试从空错误队列开始
headline.ru: Retries OpenSSL 1.x/3.x начинаются с чистой error queue

what_changed.en: ERR_clear_error is added to the dynamic and static libcrypto surfaces. CheckProc, Receive and Send call it immediately before SSL_connect, SSL_accept, SSL_read or SSL_write, as required by OpenSSL through 3.x.
what_changed.fr: ERR_clear_error est ajouté aux surfaces libcrypto dynamiques et statiques. CheckProc, Receive et Send l’appellent juste avant SSL_connect, SSL_accept, SSL_read ou SSL_write, comme requis jusqu’à OpenSSL 3.x.
what_changed.zh: 动态与静态 libcrypto surface 新增 ERR_clear_error。CheckProc、Receive、Send 在 SSL_connect、SSL_accept、SSL_read、SSL_write 前立即调用它，满足 OpenSSL 3.x 及之前要求。
what_changed.ru: ERR_clear_error добавлен в dynamic/static libcrypto surfaces. CheckProc, Receive и Send вызывают его перед SSL_connect, SSL_accept, SSL_read или SSL_write, как требуется до OpenSSL 3.x.

impact.en: Stale per-thread OpenSSL errors no longer contaminate the result of a retried handshake or I/O call, preventing false fatal classifications and misleading diagnostics on OpenSSL 1.1/3.x.
impact.fr: Les erreurs OpenSSL thread-local obsolètes ne contaminent plus un handshake ou I/O réessayé, évitant faux fatal et diagnostics trompeurs sous OpenSSL 1.1/3.x.
impact.zh: 旧的 per-thread OpenSSL error 不再污染重试 handshake 或 I/O 结果，避免 OpenSSL 1.1/3.x 上的错误 fatal 分类与误导诊断。
impact.ru: Старые per-thread OpenSSL errors больше не загрязняют retry handshake/I/O, предотвращая ложный fatal и неверную диагностику на OpenSSL 1.1/3.x.

action_detail.en: OpenSSL 1.1 and 3.x users should take build 2.4.17064 or later and retest asynchronous connect, accept, read and write failure paths.
action_detail.fr: Les utilisateurs OpenSSL 1.1/3.x doivent prendre 2.4.17064 ou plus et retester les échecs async connect, accept, read et write.
action_detail.zh: OpenSSL 1.1/3.x 用户应采用 build 2.4.17064 或更高，并复测异步 connect、accept、read、write 失败路径。
action_detail.ru: Пользователям OpenSSL 1.1/3.x следует взять build 2.4.17064 или новее и проверить async connect, accept, read и write failures.

note.en: The libcrypto error-queue reset function is now exposed through both dynamic and static OpenSSL bindings.
note.fr: La fonction de reset de la file d’erreurs libcrypto est exposée par les bindings OpenSSL dynamiques et statiques.
note.zh: libcrypto 错误队列重置函数现通过动态与静态 OpenSSL binding 公开。
note.ru: Функция сброса error queue libcrypto доступна через dynamic и static OpenSSL bindings.

headline.en: AppendSysInfo reuses one-second binary and text snapshots
headline.fr: AppendSysInfo réutilise des snapshots binaires et texte d’une seconde
headline.zh: AppendSysInfo 复用一秒期二进制与文本快照
headline.ru: AppendSysInfo переиспользует секундные binary/text snapshots

what_changed.en: RetrieveSysInfo now fills optional binary and text outputs under OSSafe from one one-second TSysInfo cache. The rendered form is cached in TShort95, and AppendSysInfo copies it into the remaining capacity of the caller's ShortString.
what_changed.fr: RetrieveSysInfo remplit des sorties binaires/texte optionnelles sous OSSafe depuis un cache TSysInfo d’une seconde. Le rendu est gardé en TShort95 et AppendSysInfo le copie dans la capacité restante de la ShortString.
what_changed.zh: RetrieveSysInfo 在 OSSafe 下从一秒 TSysInfo cache 填充可选 binary/text 输出。渲染形式缓存于 TShort95，AppendSysInfo 将其复制到调用方 ShortString 的剩余容量。
what_changed.ru: RetrieveSysInfo заполняет optional binary/text outputs под OSSafe из секундного TSysInfo cache. Текст хранится в TShort95, а AppendSysInfo копирует его в остаток ShortString.

impact.en: Repeated LevelSysInfo logging within one second avoids rebuilding processor/load/memory text and reuses the same snapshot. Values may therefore remain unchanged for up to one second by design.
impact.fr: Les logs LevelSysInfo répétés dans la seconde évitent de reconstruire le texte CPU/load/mémoire et réutilisent le même snapshot. Les valeurs peuvent rester identiques une seconde par conception.
impact.zh: 一秒内重复 LevelSysInfo 日志无需重建 CPU/load/memory 文本，并复用相同快照；因此数值按设计最多一秒不变。
impact.ru: Повторный LevelSysInfo в течение секунды не перестраивает CPU/load/memory text и использует тот же snapshot. Значения могут не меняться до секунды.

note.en: The public helper now appends a cached one-second text snapshot instead of formatting every call.
note.fr: Le helper public ajoute maintenant un snapshot texte caché une seconde au lieu de reformater chaque appel.
note.zh: 该公开 helper 现在追加缓存一秒的文本快照，而非每次调用都重新格式化。
note.ru: Публичный helper теперь добавляет секундный cached text snapshot вместо форматирования каждого вызова.
